column3: The market's default index is the build's catalog, not a hosted URL
column4: owner wants a fresh install to browse with no setup. A hosted default would add an external dependency, a fetch on first open with no network, and a file to keep in sync; the build already knows its packages
column5: builtinIndex in plugins/market/index.ts groups plugin.catalog by package; load() prepends it and leaves market.refresh summaries to configured indexes; market.entry reads a provided package's rows from the composition; market.test.ts searches with no index and asserts zero requests, then shows the preset rows
column6: kept; no new public word, no config, no fetch
